name: Demon Possessed
overview: Scripture reveals that those who are demon possessed experience severe spiritual and physical bondage, as seen in Matthew 12:22 where Jesus heals a man who was blind and mute due to demonic influence. The reality of spiritual warfare is emphasized in Ephesians 6:10,12, which teaches believers to be strong in the Lord and recognize that their true struggle is against spiritual forces of darkness. James 4:7 exhorts Christians to submit to God and resist the devil, promising that he will flee, underscoring the power of Christ-centered obedience in overcoming demonic opposition.
